target.title: fix(discord): retry stale preview cleanup after final delivery
target.body:
Closes #104865

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Discord users with partial streaming could see a stale preview beside the fresh final reply when preview cleanup failed transiently.

## Why This Change Was Made

Preview ownership is now cleared only after DELETE succeeds. Discord teardown performs one bounded cleanup retry when a fresh final was delivered but an unfinalized preview ID remains; previews finalized in place are still preserved.

This keeps retry policy at the existing lifecycle boundaries. It does not add timers, configuration, background queues, or additional final-message sends.

## User Impact

Transient Discord preview cleanup failures get one recovery attempt during normal turn teardown instead of immediately becoming unrecoverable stale messages. Final replies are still delivered exactly once.

Mattermost uses the shared helper and now also retains failed preview IDs for a later cleanup call.

## Evidence

### RED → GREEN

- Shared lifecycle regressions:
  - first DELETE rejects;
  - preview ID remains owned;
  - second clear retries DELETE and clears ownership on success;
  - if ownership advances while the old DELETE is in flight, compare-and-clear preserves the replacement preview ID.
- Discord process regression:
  - fresh final delivery succeeds once;
  - first preview clear retains the ID;
  - teardown invokes one second clear;
  - preview ID is then cleared.

Both tests failed on current `main` (`9a04fb40ce`) for the expected reasons before the implementation changes, then passed afterward.

### Passing checks

- Affected test matrix — 165 tests passed across Discord process/draft, Mattermost draft, and shared controls
- `pnpm test:contracts:channels` — 426 tests passed
- `oxfmt --check` on all four changed files
- `oxlint` on all four changed files — 0 warnings/errors
- `node scripts/check-src-extension-import-boundary.mjs --json` — `[]`
- `pnpm check` — 13/14 guards passed; the only failure was pre-existing shrinkwrap drift in root, `extensions/llama-cpp`, and `extensions/twitch`. This PR changes no package manifests, lockfiles, or shrinkwrap files.

### Wider Discord lane caveat

`pnpm test:extension discord` passed the changed Discord process and draft suites, then failed in untouched `extensions/discord/src/pluralkit.test.ts` because Node surfaced generic abort text (`This operation was aborted`) instead of the expected parent reason (`preflight stopped`). The focused retry reproduced identically.

## AI Assistance

AI-assisted by Cad from Arca. The implementation and tests were inspected and exercised directly; Codex CLI review was attempted but blocked by an expired/missing OAuth session (401), with no API-key fallback used.

target.title: test(live): retry GPT-5.6 nonce mismatches
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes a release live-provider flake where OpenAI GPT-5.6 can complete the exec/read probe successfully but return a different well-formed UUID on the first attempt. The harness immediately failed instead of using its existing bounded retry loop.

## Why This Change Was Made

GPT-5.6 variants now retry tool-read and exec/read nonce mismatches within the existing three-attempt budget. They are deliberately not added to the skip policy, so exhaustion still fails closed and continues to block release validation.

## User Impact

No runtime product behavior change. Release validation becomes resilient to a demonstrated first-attempt GPT-5.6 tool readback miss without masking deterministic failures.

## Evidence

- Prior LTS failure: run `29173852864`, job `86599663109`; the same exact target/model passed an earlier run.
- Remote live-config unit surface: 132 passed, 2 live cases skipped without credentials.
- Remote `pnpm check:changed` passed formatting, core test types, lint, and guards.
- Fresh autoreview: no accepted or actionable findings.
